posts.text: Democrat congressman Al Green, who was kicked out of the state of the union for insulting President Trump during the speech, loses his Texas Democrat primary runoff and his political career is over.
Ken Paxton has defeated John Cornyn in the Republican senate primary. Paxton will face Democrat James Talarico in November, win that election, and begin representing Texas come January in the senate.
